name: interview-prep-ai
description: AI Interview Prep Kit — monorepo root.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @interview-prep-ai/backend && npm run build --workspace @interview-prep-ai/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @interview-prep-ai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @interview-prep-ai/backend
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:backend
